name: marketplace-navpaky
description: Minimal full-stack foundation for a location-aware web platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
